Every value on this page was produced by executing underwriting.operation (a langgraph-clj StateGraph) against underwriting.store/seed-db and reading the result back out. Regenerate with clojure -M:dev:render-html. The build refuses to write this file if the scenario produced no HARD governor hold, so the page cannot quietly degrade into a demo where the governor never says no.

Rollout autonomy matrix

Computed at build time by calling underwriting.phase/gate for every (phase, op) pair with a governor-clean verdict, so this table is the gate itself rather than a description of it. Default phase is 3. A cell only ever answers “how much autonomy does the phase grant”; the governor still runs first and can override any of them down to a hold.

Jurisdiction spec-basis catalog

The official sources the governor checks every jurisdiction proposal against. cloud-itonami-isic-6511 R0: 6 jurisdictions seeded with an official spec-basis. This is a starting catalog, not a survey of all ~194 jurisdictions -- extend `underwriting.facts/catalog`, never fabricate a jurisdiction's requirements. Covered: 6 of 6.
